name: Knee Plank
research: Face down (root rot X 90 = prone, head -Y); body sloped up toward the head by 16.7 deg -> rot X 73.3. Shoulder joint height = upper arm 0.269 + elbow 0.045 = 0.315; knee joint ~0.04-0.05. Shoulder->knee along the body 0.92, rise 0.265 -> asin(0.265/0.92) = 16.7 deg. Rotated shoulder offset z +0.062 -> root z 0.253; shoulders (+-0.22,-0.471,0.315), hip L (0.11,-0.018,0.205), straight-line knee (0.15,0.407,0.041). Thigh 0.45 from the hip lands the knee there; shin lies on the floor behind: ankle (0.12,0.857,0.07) (hip-ankle 0.885 -> knee bend ~21 deg, the angle between the sloping thigh and the flat shin); tops of the feet down (rot X 170: toes point +Y, slightly into the floor). Knee pole below (+front of the knee faces the floor). Arms: world down in the torso frame = (0,0.958,-0.287) -> elev 73.3, plane 90 = upper arm vertical, elbow under the shoulder; elbow 90 with bend_world -Y lays the forearm flat toward the head, hand ~0.045 high; fists thumb-up (axis = world up in the torso frame). Sources S1 NASM plank progressions, S2 Calatayud 2019, S3 Schoenfeld 2014. QA 11 Nov: whole body moved by the measured lowest point so it rests on the floor (cloud run 43079162675). 13 Nov 2026 (pics-fixes): camera low (pitch 3) from the front-side (yaw -35) so the abs under the body show red; 'ground' with _tilt pitches the body until both forearms and knees touch the floor.
